paper_title: First Results from Axion Haloscope at CAPP around 10.7 $μ$eV
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1 (approximate, from KSVZ scaling)
notes: Haloscope search around 10.7 ueV. Two regimes: KSVZ-sensitivity band 10.7126-10.7186 ueV (near KSVZ coupling ~6e-16 GeV^-1) and wider 10.16-11.37 ueV band at ~9x KSVZ (~5.4e-15 GeV^-1). KSVZ coupling at ~2.6 GHz is roughly g_agamma~6.6e-16 GeV^-1; values are approximate since exact numeric limits not tabulated (only quoted as multiples of KSVZ). ma from Table I.
